text:
ana.security: Heads up — audit-scan found a PGP-encrypted tar in partner S3 with Vault auto-backups + several legacy service keys. Exposure window ~36h. Filing containment.
matt.platform: copying runbook 'secrets/backup-exposure'. first step: snapshot affected objects and lock them down. which exact object(s)?
ana.security: path example: `s3://partner-backups/redwood-prod-2026-03-20.tar.gpg`. likely affected services: analytics-ingest, worker-runner-old, legacy-webhook. tar contains `vault-backup-2026-03-20/*` and `keys/legacy/*.pem` (PGP-encrypted).
jess.ops: oncall starting containment. plan: revoke live Vault leases for legacy paths, disable legacy auth roles, and create temporary KEK for rewrap. cc @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: started revokes — running:
```
# revoke leases
vault lease revoke -prefix secret/legacy-worker
# disable legacy role auth
vault write auth/aws/role/legacy-worker ttl=0
```
Revokes in progress, ETA ~8m. Creating temp KMS CMK now for rewrap.
matt.platform: for service creds: we'll treat as exposed -> rotate to short-lived tokens and reissue. For PGP key (if used to decrypt backups) we need to rotate PGP and re-encrypt archives. Propose:
1) generate new PGP key
2) reencrypt backups with new key
3) delete old GPG objects after verification
jess.ops: applying S3 ACL lockdown to prevent partner read on backup prefix. also enabling S3 access logs to secure bucket. running:
```
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket partner-backups --policy file://deny-partner-backups.json
aws s3api put-bucket-logging --bucket partner-backups --bucket-logging-status file://enable-logging.json
```
ci-deploy-bot: infra PR 4512 merged -> iam: deny-partner-backups-read policy rolled out to accounts (deploy 3372 successful).
ops-oncall: temp CMK created: `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/temp-rewrap-2026-03-20` — starting rewrap of wrapped keys in vault transit space. will post when complete.
ana.security: summary action items (assignments):
- jess.ops: confirm S3 policy + access logs, delete public ACLs on prefix
- ops-oncall: complete rewrap and rotate KEK, confirm KMS key usage and schedule rekey
- matt.platform: rotate exposed service creds to short-lived, update deployments
- ana.security: coordinate PGP reissue + reencrypt backup flow, run integrity checks then scrub old objects
matt.platform: also pushing RBAC change to deny S3:GetObject for partner role on `partner-backups/*` (policy id: deny-partner-backups-read). Will link PR.
ana.security: please annotate all steps in the incident tracker and attach object manifest + checksums. We'll run full postmortem once containment done. :rotating_light: :lock:
